title: Use an anonymous function
summary: Elixir: Use an anonymous function. Call twice.(7).
introduction: fn creates a function value. A dot is used when calling a function stored in a variable.
learningObjectives: Use an anonymous function with Elixir

blocks.text: Install Elixir. Save each example as lesson.exs and run elixir lesson.exs.

blocks.title: Use an anonymous function
blocks.code:
twice = fn n -> n * 2 end
IO.puts(twice.(4))

blocks.text: The function body doubles n. The dot call supplies input 4.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not omit the dot in this kind of function call.
